after_fields.inference_substrate_correction_note:
CORRECTED 2026-07-27 by the outer loop. The original value 'offline_arc_agi3_perception_planner_real_env_confirmed' is not in scripts/arc_artifact_lint.py's legal set, so this artifact blocked EVERY commit that staged it -- and it has been invalid since it was written (byte-identical at HEAD). The replacement is the legal value that describes what the run actually did, established by reading the artifact rather than guessing: duration_s=0.2 with NO gguf / llama / llm / cuda / torch / model_specs / induction reference anywhere in the file, i.e. a pure offline-arcade agent run with no LLM tier. That substrate's duration floor is 0.01s, which 0.2s clears, so the relabel does not launder a too-fast run past a stricter floor. The original string is preserved above per CLAUDE.md never-prune; no measurement value was touched.

ADVERSARIAL REVIEW ADDENDUM (2026-07-27, same day). Three things the original note did not say. (1) The substrate was re-confirmed by READING THE SCRIPT, not merely by the absence of gguf/llama/llm strings in the artifact: scripts/experiments/experiment_3946_r11l_first_solve.py constructs Arcade(arc_api_key='', operation_mode=OperationMode.OFFLINE, environments_dir=ENVDIR) and steps the offline sim directly, and imports no llama_cpp / transformers / torch / cuda anywhere. So no LLM ran and nothing was laundered past a stricter duration floor. (2) THE RELABEL MADE THIS ARTIFACT AUDITABLE FOR THE FIRST TIME, and that is a change in its own right: measured directly, scripts/adversarial_verify.py returns 0 flags on a reconstructed pre-relabel copy and 1 WARN (METHODOLOGY_MISSING: reproducibility_checksum) on the corrected file. The old string matched no substrate classifier, so it escaped every check -- an illegal value was quieter than a legal one. The new WARN is REAL and is not being suppressed: CLAUDE.md's substrate table requires random_seed AND reproducibility_checksum for offline_arcade_live_agent_runtime_self_discovery_no_llm; this artifact has random_seed=42 and NO reproducibility_checksum. It cannot be back-computed from a completed run and will NOT be fabricated. (3) The script reads engine internals (env._game and env._game.yfbjozweime) for ground-truth piece/target pairs, so 'self_discovery' in the substrate name describes the OFFLINE-ARCADE-no-LLM half of the value, not a claim that the live agent discovered this game unaided; the legal set offers no more precise value. Treat the solve_provenance as development_proxy at best.
